values: 一名强大的坦克，身边总是环绕着不息的风雪，能够保护友军使其免受伤害。
A stalwart Tank who summons swirling snowstorms to shield allies from incoming damage.
我的枪更加锋利了。……呵啊！
You will remember the touch of winter.
寒冬独行于世，对敌人绝不姑息。
We're born alone to this cold world... So no mercy for our enemies.
这支冰枪已伴我许久。现在，它会为你而战。
This spear has been with me for an eternity... Now it fights for you.
My homeland... Yes... let us go.
A warrior does not need this.
阿尔娜有很多称呼：凛风歌者、群山守护者、永恒冻土之母……世人常常称呼她为冬喉女士，以表达对她的敬意与崇拜。
Singer of the Wind, Guardian of the Mountains, Mother of the Snowland—these are just a few of Alna's many titles. Most know her as the Frozen Mother, a name uttered with reverence.
生活在北地的人们都听过关于阿尔娜的故事：呼啸的北风是她的怒吼，不息的风雪是她的战袍，是她将冬天带到了伊索米亚。
Alna is renowned in the north as the one who brought winter to Esperia. The howling wind is her roar, the ceaseless snow forms her armor.
见过阿尔娜的战斗后，人们会不自觉地心生对神明的崇敬：当她出征时，冰天雪地便成了她踏向世界的桥梁。
To witness Alna in action is to be overcome with awe. When she marches to war, ice and snow rise up to form the path that carries her across the world.
阿尔娜有一位名为格尼兹的矮人朋友。每隔几年，她都会回到两人一同奋战过的地方，献上她的敬意。
Alna once had a dwarf companion named Ginneas, now long departed. Every few years, she returns to the battlefield where they fought side by side to honor his memory.
最初，格尼兹认为阿尔娜冰冷孤傲，不近人情；当他们从魔物的层层包围中杀出一条血路时，他才发现阿尔娜有着比锻炉还要炽热的灵魂。
At first, Ginneas saw Alna as aloof and unapproachable. It wasn't until they fought their way out of a Hypogean encirclement that he realized her soul burned hotter than any forge.
半神皆对阿尔娜持有一份特别的敬意。伊莱亚和莱拉总说，巴赫朗在她的面前像个孩子。
Alna is highly respected among the Celestials. According to Elijah and Lailah, Baelran behaves like a child whenever he is around Alna.
亚莉克希认为阿尔娜非常适合说人类的冷笑话，因为她光是呼吸就散发着寒气。阿尔娜对此不予置评。
Aliceth thinks Alna would be great at telling jokes, since her awkward delivery is hilarious on its own. Alna, however, remains noncommittal about the suggestion.
阿尔娜出身于极北之地，其亲族全部死于恶魔眷属之手，故乡也已覆灭，世间再无记载流传。
Alna hails from the far north, where her entire family was slain by Hypogean minions and her homeland destroyed, leaving no trace in the world.
阿尔娜的信念支撑着她奋战至今，直至将恶魔赶尽杀绝的那一天，自己才有资格死去。
Alna's unwavering conviction drives her forward. She will endure until the day every Hypogean is vanquished.
人们会用冷水海域出产的鳕鱼烹饪成浓汤，款待途经此地的冬喉女士——据说，这是她唯一肯接受的赠礼。
Whenever Alna passes through, people serve her a hearty soup made from cod. The dish is said to be the only gift she will accept.
赫托啊！我没看错，真的是冬喉女士！
Helthor above! I wasn't imagining things... It really is the Frozen Mother!
